That's like this, like I'm sitting now. Reinhardt used to tell you to sit in a "T" position because you got more breath control that way. You know, Keg caused me to go with him.

I wonder -- Butter and I were just talking about these trombones and things. I just want to digress a little bit. We're up through Cab's band, but I'd like to digress and just talk about some personalities of our era, some of the guys that you might have run into, and I just want to find out your impressions in which you knew about them.
